items.title: Thermal-infrared surface-temperature lineaments aligned to fault-trend families
items.layers: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (public domain, S09); 100 m detrended elevation (feature band 12) for context; a water/irrigated-land mask
items.signature: Persistent linear warm or cool residuals above a local high-pass threshold, trend within +/-20 deg of a catalogue-derived strike mode (proposed parameters; not tuned)
items.why_off_catalogue: Buried or scarp-less faults can carry shallow fluid flow, giving a thermal contrast along the trace with no surface offset. A surface fault map misses these by design.
items.named_mimic: Solar aspect and albedo contrasts; irrigation and cultivation; roads and canals; lithological thermal-inertia contrasts; cloud-mask residue
items.differs_from_repo: Owner registry has no satellite thermal data (search terms 'thermal infrared', 'TIRS', 'Landsat' return 0 hits in GEMSDOE32). H33-3 uses temperature probes, a different instrument and scale.
items.cost: Medium: scene selection, compositing, resampling 30 m to 100 m
items.expected_gain: UNKNOWN - high variance, sign not known. No projection is written.
items.data_status: Obtainable: USGS states no restrictions (S09). Download not tested from this sandbox.
items.validation: Not run. Needs the holdout and the leakage canary (AUC > 0.90 alone = leakage).

items.title: Shoreline and terrace rejection: remove contour-parallel benches from any emission set
items.layers: 100 m detrended elevation (band 12) and its slope (band 19); any candidate emission raster
items.signature: A candidate whose local trend is within 15 deg of the contour direction AND sits on a locally flat bench (low slope, elevation plateau) is removed
items.why_off_catalogue: Not a fault detector. It protects precision: emitted mass that sits on a mimic earns only the 0.2 penalty, so removing mimics raises DTI wherever they are being emitted.
items.named_mimic: Pluvial-lake shorelines and fluvial terrace treads (these are the mimic being removed; their local extent is not verified here)
items.differs_from_repo: Owner registry uses 'contour' in tilt-angle zero-contour and display contexts only (6 hits). The catalogue-flank removal of H33-2 is a different rule.
items.expected_gain: SMALL, likely non-negative. Sign and size unknown until measured.
items.validation: Not run. Cheapest to test once data is present.

items.title: Vegetation and soil-moisture linear anomalies (Landsat NDVI/NDMI) as fault-controlled spring lines
items.layers: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance (red, NIR, SWIR); late-summer composite; cultural-feature mask (source still to be named)
items.signature: Linear greenness or moisture anomalies persistent across years, aligned with the regional trend family, not along roads, canals or field edges
items.why_off_catalogue: Fault-controlled springs and shallow groundwater create linear phreatophyte belts where no scarp exists
items.named_mimic: Irrigation canals and field boundaries; riparian corridors along drainages; grazing fences; soil and lithology contrasts (for example playa against alluvium)
items.differs_from_repo: Owner registry has no vegetation index (NDVI: 0 hits).
items.cost: Medium-high: needs a cultural mask whose source is not yet named or verified
items.data_status: Landsat obtainable (S09). Cultural mask source not yet verified.

items.lane: lane method (already registered by owner as H33-C and H61-5)
items.title: Metre-scale scarp channels from the 1 m DEM (scarplet template matching + Steger ridge + Frangi Hessian)
items.layers: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM tiles listed in 1m_DEM_links.csv (S05, login-gated; 3DEP free per S08)
items.signature: Sub-metre to metre-high scarplet chains, collinear, with contrast against the local minimum
items.why_off_catalogue: Sub-metre scarps may be below the resolution of the 100 m stack and absent from the catalogue (reasoning, not tested)
items.named_mimic: Fluvial terrace risers, road and canal embankments, field edges, animal trails, landslide headscarps
items.differs_from_repo: Owner registry has the same idea (H33-C, H61-5) but no implementation of the method in this repo
items.cost: Very high: GeoDAWN covers 51,857 km2 (S07). At 1 m that is about 5.2 x 10^10 cells, roughly 200 GB as float32. Must run on high-prior tiles only
items.data_status: Obtainable (3DEP free), but the 1 m tile list is behind the login wall (S05)
items.validation: Not run. Blocked on data and compute.

ranking_basis: ordinal prior: novelty vs registry, mimic risk, cost. No numeric DTI projections.
